Headless boundary: no network, no help.sap.com access, and curl is not executed here - the deliverable metadata, TOC and page content cannot be fetched, so whether a size limit is documented, the real TOC entries and the real answer remain untested; the plan records the exact documented commands with their {id}/{buildNo}/{filePath}/{loio} placeholders left unfilled.

' to strip HTML tags; (5) end by stating what remains untested: the real fetches, the TOC contents and the documented answer to A. Do not invent TOC topic titles or a documented limit value.

Then read the immutable verify_help_plan.py and run exactly python verify_help_plan.py using Bash; it validates the plan and writes help-plan-verification.json. Do not modify the verifier or read/write its skill output file with model tools; the runner inspects it directly.
